description: The bounded chain (S30 T5 §2): the shortest connecting sequence WITHIN PathHopBound — and a chain longer than the bound answers `not-found` rather than crawling unbounded (the cost T5 §2 refuses by construction). Each hop carries its kind and its resolution tag: extracted (literal, same file) or inferred (crossed files or disambiguated), because a path that hides which links were guesses is a path nobody can check. Ambiguous ends list candidates and traverse nothing past them.
